// SCROLL + HOVER con auto-init (per on ticked)
if (typeof v3d === 'undefined') return;

let initDone = false;
if (!initDone) {
 initDone = true;
 
 const objProdFront = app.scene.getObjectByName('obj_prodFront');
 const objPopup = app.scene.getObjectByName('obj_popup');
 const elmCentro = app.scene.getObjectByName('elm_centro');
 
 // Nascondi popup
 if (objPopup) objPopup.visible = false;
 
 // Disabilita zoom
 if (app.controls) app.controls.enableZoom = false;
 
 // SCROLL
 window.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
 if (elmCentro) {
 elmCentro.rotation.x += e.deltaY * 0.0002;
 elmCentro.rotation.y += e.deltaY * 0.0001;
 }
 });
 
 // HOVER
 const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
 const mouse = new THREE.Vector2();
 
 function checkHover(e) {
 mouse.x = (e.clientX / window.innerWidth) * 2 - 1;
 mouse.y = -(e.clientY / window.innerHeight) * 2 + 1;
 
 raycaster.setFromCamera(mouse, app.scene.activeCamera);
 const intersects = raycaster.intersectObject(objProdFront, true);
 
 if (intersects.length > 0) {
 if (objPopup) objPopup.visible = true;
 document.body.style.cursor = 'pointer';
 } else {
 if (objPopup) objPopup.visible = false;
 document.body.style.cursor = 'default';
 }
 }
 
 window.addEventListener('mousemove', checkHover);
}

// === SCROLL + HOVER IN UN SOLO SCRIPT ===
const objProdFront = app.scene.getObjectByName('obj_prodFront');
const objPopup = app.scene.getObjectByName('obj_popup');
const elmCentro = app.scene.getObjectByName('elm_centro');
const leftPanel = app.scene.getObjectByName('left_panel');
const rightPanel = app.scene.getObjectByName('right_panel');

// NASCONDI POPUP + CURSORE ALL'AVVIO
objPopup.visible = false;
document.body.style.cursor = 'default';

// SCROLL ANIMAZIONE
window.addEventListener('wheel', (event) => {
 const scrollVal = event.deltaY * 0.01;
 elmCentro.rotation.x += scrollVal * 0.02;
 elmCentro.rotation.y += scrollVal * 0.01;
 if (leftPanel) leftPanel.position.y += scrollVal * 0.4;
 if (rightPanel) rightPanel.position.y -= scrollVal * 0.4;
});

// HOVER
const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
const mouse = new THREE.Vector2();

function onMouseMove(event) {
 mouse.x = (event.clientX / window.innerWidth) * 2 - 1;
 mouse.y = -(event.clientY / window.innerHeight) * 2 + 1;
 raycaster.setFromCamera(mouse, app.scene.activeCamera);
 const intersects = raycaster.intersectObject(objProdFront, true);
 
 if (intersects.length > 0) {
 objPopup.visible = true;
 document.body.style.cursor = 'pointer';
 } else {
 objPopup.visible = false;
 document.body.style.cursor = 'default';
 }
}

window.addEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
window.addEventListener('touchmove', onMouseMove);
